name: openproject-cli
description: Interact with OpenProject projects, work packages, users, and time entries via the API.

openproject_api_key.title: OPENPROJECT_API_KEY
openproject_api_key.description: API token from My Account > Access tokens > API. Preferred over username/password.

openproject_password.title: OPENPROJECT_PASSWORD
openproject_password.description: Your OpenProject password. Only used if no API key is set.

openproject_username.title: OPENPROJECT_USERNAME
openproject_username.description: Your OpenProject login email. Only used if no API key is set.

openproject_url.title: OPENPROJECT_URL
openproject_url.description: Base URL of the OpenProject instance.
